user_outcome: Agents preserve the engine's exact primary/context relationship and authority in concise final responses; humans are not told that a structural claim changed numbers when the immutable primary already reflects it.

engine_vs_agent.distinction: Engine fields were checked before language scoring; final-response success was not used to infer engine completeness.

retained_behavior: typed relationship_to_primary in the compact context outcome
deterministic primary, automation, source, consequence, and citation projections
final-response scoring that fails closed on unknown relationship types
complete artifact path as immutable source of truth
remaining_risks: Four structural cases and one model/provider validate a regression shard, not universal model-language preservation.
P8 does not establish new forecast accuracy; it validates transmission of an existing engine contract.
Future relationship types require deliberate deterministic projections and preservation scorers before they can pass.
